note: Only flagged items are listed. All remaining proposals were checked against source text, available speaker and context; no game runtime claim.

flags.en: Coop and Punch Up knew each other from before the Z-Team. Some people say they've been intimate.
flags.before: عرفت كوب وبانش أب بعضهما قبل فريق Z. يقول البعض إنهما أقاما علاقة حميمة.

flags.reason: كوب مؤنثة، فلا يجوز أن يكون حذف تاء الفعل وحده تصحيحًا لـ«عرفت كوب». وضع الاسمين قبل الفعل وتثنيته يتجنب الخطأ ويحافظ على معرفة كل منهما الآخر.

flags.en: They’re right, I don’t deserve anyone's forgiveness, anyone's help, anyone's love... |because I can never repay it. |Nothing I do will ever make up for what I’ve already done to you. |I’d hoped getting the Astral Pulse back would help but... |I couldn’t even do that.

flags.en: Told you guys. Dude was one divorce away from a total robot uprising.

flags.en: Goddamn. Alright. Somebody’s a little fuckin’ impatient.
